title: Sphere index
description: An image collection wraps over a dark spherical surface, then unfolds one selected work into a flat plate.
useCase: Explore a compact image index spatially while keeping a readable inspection state.
interaction: Orbit the sphere and open a work.

assets.description: Untitled (Fern Study), c. 1850, from the Hatton Fern Album
Shower Below the Summit (Sanka hakuu), from the series "Thirty-Six Views of Mount Fuji (Fugaku sanjurokkei)"

reducedMotion: Orbit controls respond directly and selected images flatten immediately.
limitations: Six unique works repeat across eighteen tessellated tiles. Canvas 2D projection approximates a sphere; this is not a WebGL scene or general panorama viewer.
look: Near-black plum background with woodblock prints and botanical images warped into curved tiles on a sphere, small uppercase header and italic serif caption.
motion: Dragging or arrow keys orbit the tiled sphere directly; opening a tile exponentially eases its mesh from curved to a flat centred plate while the other tiles fade out.
adapt: One canvas effect does everything: `point` projects longitude and latitude with `yaw` and `pitch`, `triangle` affine-maps image triangles, and `tick` eases `amount` toward `target` (75 ms time constant) to flatten. Replace `works`; `tiles` sets the 18-tile layout.
